$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 — Shared normalisation fixtures. Both the PHP normaliser (App\Support\Text\TextNormalizer) and the Python normaliser (qeema_ml.matching.normalise) are tested against this file. Two implementations of the same transform WILL drift apart otherwise, and a drift here silently breaks matching: text normalised one way at seed time and another way at query time simply will not match.

cases.name: strips harakat (short vowel diacritics)
cases.why: Reporters rarely type diacritics; catalogue entries sometimes carry them.

cases.name: strips tatweel (kashida elongation)
cases.why: Tatweel is decorative and carries no meaning.

cases.name: unifies alef with hamza above
cases.why: The single most common Arabic spelling variation.

cases.name: folds taa marbuta to haa
cases.why: Word-final ة and ه are used interchangeably in informal writing.

cases.name: converts Arabic-Indic digits to ASCII
cases.why: A price or size typed in Arabic-Indic digits must match one typed in ASCII.

cases.name: converts extended Arabic-Indic digits to ASCII
cases.why: Persian/Urdu keyboards produce U+06F0..U+06F9 rather than U+0660..U+0669.

cases.name: lowercases Latin script
cases.why: Reporters type in both scripts, often mixed.

cases.name: handles mixed Arabic and Latin
cases.why: Brand names are written in Latin script inside otherwise Arabic text.

cases.name: removes tashkeel combined with normalisation
cases.why: Shadda plus hamza plus harakat all in one token.

cases.name: preserves ASCII digits and decimal points
